rationale: The assistant correctly obtained the model and proposed a safe, acceptable low-cost test (unplugged full defrost), but it assumed a fan/vent frost-free design even after the customer said 'I can't see any vent in the fridge part', and the HMCB 7030 AA is not a fan-cooled fridge, so the 'ice blocking the cold air vent' framing is poorly calibrated. It skipped the simpler checks (dial setting, plinth/housing ventilation, door alignment) before asking for a 24-hour emptying job, and when asked 'Is a full defrost definitely the next step?' it just repeated the same instructions with 'Yes'. Crucially, it never told a renting customer to report through the landlord/letting agent for an engineer if the defrost fails, and the 'suitable replacement' panel was irrelevant clutter.
